verdict.rationale: HubSpot's knowledge base documents a sequences tool for sending a series of targeted, timed email templates to prospects [hubspot-docs-37, hubspot-docs-44, hubspot-docs-52]. Connecting a work inbox lets users send one-to-one emails and sequence emails directly from the CRM and log replies [hubspot-docs-13, hubspot-docs-21]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and fuller detail on standalone email templates and sequence step configuration (the sequence doc snippets are truncated).
